title: AI Gold Rush Lures Crypto Firms Away from Bitcoin
seoTitle: AI Lures Crypto Firms, Pulls Focus from Bitcoin
subtitle: Crypto companies pivot to AI as Bitcoin rises but remains far from last year's peak.
excerpt: Bitcoin saw a price surge in August but is still far from its year-ago peak. Meanwhile, crypto firms are reallocating resources to AI and retooling their mining operations.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Bitcoin's price saw a surge during August, but it remains considerably below the peak reached nearly a year ago.

Concurrently, companies in the crypto sector are channeling efforts into the so-called "AI gold rush." This shift has led to a diversion of resources and attention from Bitcoin to artificial intelligence projects.

As part of this reorientation, these companies are retooling their mining operations, adapting infrastructure to meet new technological demands.

With information from BBC News.
